question: Select the correctly spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Behaviour**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• "Behaviour" is the correct spelling of the word. 
 
• The word **"Behaviour"** means the way in which one acts or conducts oneself, especially towards others. (व्यवहार)
 
 
• **Example: **His behaviour towards his colleagues was always courteous and respectful.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Behaviour.**
